quest.title: The Illumiscreen: II
quest.description: Brother Qian from the Liyue Adventurers' Guild is still inviting people to try playing with the Illumiscreen...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Festive Fever x200

talks.objective: Talk to Brother Qian at night (21:00 – 05:00)

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. You've come at a good time. I've changed to a new set of lanterns since the last time you were here.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Fancy giving it a try, seeing if you can solve this one? It won't be as easy as last time.

choices.text: Why? Is the image more complex?

response.speaker: Brother Qian
response.text: No, no. The image is easy to spot, and there are still only three parts to combine.

response.speaker: Brother Qian
response.text: The difficulty this time has to do with the lantern rotation part.

response.speaker: Brother Qian
response.text: Okay, so, the image to make today is <color=#00E1FFFF>Mora</color>. Remember, you have to get the right image first before you can go looking for the treasure.

choices.text: Is the lantern rotation more difficult?

response.speaker: Brother Qian
response.text: Hehehe, this time the three lanterns are <color=#00E1FFFF>linked together</color>.

response.speaker: Brother Qian
response.text: To put it simply, when you rotate a lantern, there's a possibility that one of the other ones will rotate, too.

response.speaker: Brother Qian
response.text: Give it a go, you'll see what I mean.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: How is the treasure hunt going?

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: All of it? You're quite the expert treasure hunter, then... Plenty of people give up and walk off after the first try...

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Since you found all the treasure... Please take these as your prize. Happy Lantern Rite!

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: The treasure has all been prepared specially by the Guild. Happy hunting.

talks.objective: Find the treasure area indicated by the Illumiscreen

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: If you'd like to have a try, please come back at nighttime.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: The new Illumiscreen isn't set up yet. Come back when it's ready.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: The image to try and make today is <color=#00E1FFFF>Mora</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: You've solved it already? You're becoming very good at this very quickly. Go and study the image, there's a treasure clue hidden in it.
